rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.

L116: "the `**Note**` widget it used to occupy was the slide's only content, which is not what a Note is for" is undated journey narration (uses the explicitly-banned "used to") explaining HOW the current plain-bullet layout came to be rather than stating the standing constraint. Not shielded by the dated-provenance carve-out since it carries no date of its own and sits in elaboration, not a header.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Drop the "used to occupy" clause; state the constraint directly, e.g. "a Note widget is louder than surrounding prose and this ask doesn't need that weight, so it sits as a plain bullet."
